title: Independent review of published whole-book scoped and contextual outputs
question: What did the whole-book scoped and contextual reports preserve, misread or omit?
method: Read all exact completed whole-view reports at report and category level. Review a bounded, native-anchored set of contribution chains against the original source. Independently check all six contextual reports, all nine output edges and selected printed citations that did not enter the scoped cue population.

agents.separation: Assess the published outputs independently from the executing agent.

outputs.role: All 29 scoped report census rows and sampled exact chains
All six contextual reports and nine relationship inputs and outputs
Exact native cut custody and report populations
Independent LLM dispositions and source-grounded examples

results.name: Scoped views independently assessed at report level
Contextual proposals matching both source citation and target heading
Independently confirmed source citations missing from the contextual input

conclusion: The report census and sampled source checks distinguish correct native locations from semantic errors, including lost qualifier scope and unsupported procedure links. All nine emitted contextual proposals agree with the source and heading. Four independently checked printed citations never entered contextual retrieval because the scoped producer did not emit their cues.
